slides.body: Dolphins running back De’Von Achane reportedly suffered a torn ACL against Kansas City.

slides.headline: That means his 2026 season is over
slides.body: Reports say Achane will miss the rest of the season after the ACL tear.

slides.headline: That deepens Miami’s 0-3 start

slides.headline: And it hits a third-round pick from 2023
slides.body: Miami selected Achane in the third round, 84th overall, in the 2023 NFL draft.

slides.headline: Which follows his Week 3 rookie breakout
slides.body: In Week 3 of 2023, Achane had 203 rushing yards, 30 receiving yards and 4 total touchdowns as Miami beat Denver 70-20.

slides.headline: So the next question is Miami’s RB room
slides.body: Reports are now tracking Miami’s running back depth and possible free-agent options after Achane’s injury.
